feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 5 June 2026 6:18am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

West 4 or 5, backing SW this morning. Further backing South or SE in afternoon and evening, then increasing SE 6 or 7 tonight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough tonight.


##Weather)##

Fair, only isolated showers, then rain and drizzle soon arriving tonight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor tonight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

SE 6 or 7, decreasing 4 or 5 later in morning and early afternoon. Further decreasing 3 or 4 by evening, veering West or NW later in evening, then backing SW 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Rain and drizzle soon turning light and patchy, clearing later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor, improving good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C

##Warnings)##

##State of sea)##

##Weather)##

##Visibility)##
